Web-grounded answers from the Agent API, raw web search results, and embeddings.

## API key

1. Open [console.perplexity.ai](https://console.perplexity.ai/project/keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from the Perplexity console.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add perplexity
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  perplexity: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Perplexity's [API](https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/agent-post) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show perplexity` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Agent API per token plus tool fees (web\_search $0.0025 a call); Search API $5 per 1,000 requests.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Perplexity).
